## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES
- Hot window is one year for every Tenant; read the `Audit-Hot-Window-Start` response header and show it in an info caption. **Export…** (flag `audit_export`): `POST /audit-exports {…the current filters, format: ndjson|csv}` (Idempotency-Key) → 202; poll `GET /audit-exports/{id}` every 3 s while `pending`/`running`, then offer `download_url` (signed for 15 minutes: re-fetch the export for a fresh link; kept 7 days). 429 → 20 exports a day. New actions to group in the filter: subscription.*, push_credential.*, device.deleted, audit.exported, user.sessions_revoked, user.expired.

## For developers

Loads: `GET /audit-events?since&until&actor_type&actor_id&action&target_type&target_id&target_user_id&application_id&organization_id&tenant_id`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
